description: Delete one monitor: it stops being checked and disappears from the organization's monitors, and no tool restores it. Use it only when the user explicitly asked for deletion; otherwise prefer pause_monitor, which keeps the monitor and its history. There is no bulk delete. Requires a key with the write scope. Returns {"success": true}.

monitor_id.description: The monitor's uuid from list_monitors. An id that is not a monitor of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

name: delete_monitor
title: Delete a monitor
